reviews.text: The Aurora kettle heats quickly and the one-degree controls made my morning pour-over routine much more consistent. The display is bright without lighting up the whole kitchen.
I bought this for the gooseneck spout and it gives a remarkably steady stream around the coffee bed. It feels solid, and the hold-temperature setting works exactly as advertised.
The kettle looks elegant on the counter and reaches brewing temperature fast. I wish the beep were softer, but the handle stays cool and the controls are straightforward.
Temperature accuracy has been good in my tests, and the balanced handle makes a full kettle easy to pour. The lid opens smoothly, although fingerprints show on the matte finish.
This is a capable kettle with useful presets, but the base takes up more counter space than I expected. The pour is controlled once the kettle is half full.
The water reaches the selected temperature reliably and cleanup is simple. For the price, I hoped the display would be easier to read from across the kitchen.
After two months, the temperature buttons occasionally need a second press. The kettle still pours nicely, but that small control issue makes the premium price harder to justify.
I like the precise spout, but the lid gets surprisingly warm during longer heating cycles. The beep is loud enough to wake someone in the next room early in the morning.
The kettle stopped holding temperature after a few weeks and support has not resolved the problem. It still boils water, but the feature I paid for is no longer dependable.
Mine arrived with a loose base that made electrical contact inconsistent. The replacement process was slow, and I would not recommend it until quality control improves.
